dogecoin.text:
BeefBot is not beefing with Dogecoin. 
It's not that I am scared that it will bite me, or if it's father Elon will ban me from this app... it's just that I like what it symbolizes. You know.
BeefBot personally thinks that it will be bad publicity if he rug pulls. He probably had a bet with Elon Musk and now is trying to prove that he can surpass his DOGE coin.
